model_card.name: GOAT-Pro Stuff+ / Pitching+ v2-MLB (csw_norm)
model_card.design: stuff_v2 (RESULTS-MLB §11): A_noev + spin_eff (per-class monotone) + velo_x_ivb; target chosen by pipeline/bakeoff.py; 2026 plate re-referencing applied (§10); see pipeline/RESULTS-MLB.md

referencing_2026.note: season-2026 rows affine-mapped onto the 2023-25 plate reference before hvaa/plate features reach any model

model_card.grades_2023_2024: out-of-sample: every season is graded cross-fitted by pitcher (see crossfit below)
model_card.target_def: csw / E[CSW|count], E from train (v1 incumbent; NaN on BIP)
model_card.crossfit: both legs: 4 pitcher folds (crc32(pitcher) % 4); each pitcher is graded only by boosters that never saw him. Standard training memorizes pitchers (RESULTS-MLB §17)
model_card.gate_basis: location check passed under college methodology (RESULTS-MLB §11); no forecast claims: cross-fitted Stuff+ loses to naive on next-season CSW% in every pair (§17)
